def: An uxorious, effeminate, or spiritless man. [Obs.] Johnson.
Of, pertaining to, or produced by, lithotypy.
The whole set of whorls of a spiral shell.
Depending on some uncertain contingency; as, an aleatorycontract. Bouvier.
One of the Pectinibranchiata. Also used adjectively.
One who, or that which, tarries.
A nerve or tendon, supposed to brace and sustain the heart.Shak.Sobbing, as if a hearstring broke. Moore.
A lighthouse, or the apparatus placed in it for giving light.
